_comment: THE env.* CAPABILITY CONTRACT, shared by the hosted stubs and the CLI emulator.
Each entry is the MINIMUM grant level a function needs to call that method. Two
implementations enforce this — src/functions/api/*.ts in the private worker, and
cli/internal/functions/bindings.go here — and neither can import the other, so before
this file they were two hand-written ladders that had already drifted three times.
A divergence is not cosmetic: a method that needs 'full' hosted but 'write' locally
runs fine on a developer's machine and 403s in production.
An ARRAY means the level depends on the arguments; the values are the possible levels,
lowest first. Only channel.token does this: minting a subscriber token is a read, minting
a publish-capable one is a write.
Both sides assert against this file. Edit it only when the capability itself changes.
